display_long_description:
Ignite your passion for speed in the most immersive VR racing experience yet!

Racing Fever: Car Racing Game puts you directly in the driver’s seat of powerful racing machines. Whether you are a casual driver or a simulation enthusiast, this game offers the perfect balance of realistic physics and exhilarating arcade action.

Key Features:

Custom Garage & Upgrades: Personalize your vehicle in a high-tech showroom. Modify your car with custom neon lighting, spoilers, roof attachments, and unique rim designs.

Performance Tuning: Adjust your car's suspension and performance to match your driving style, ensuring you have the edge on every corner.

Diverse Racing Tracks: Compete on multiple professional circuits, including scenic forest tracks and mountainous coastal roads, each offering unique challenges and obstacles.

Immersive VR Cockpit: Feel the vibration of the engine and the tension of the steering wheel with a detailed first-person interior view and interactive VR hands.

Competitive Leaderboards: Race against AI opponents and track your standing on the "Racer List". Can you beat Alex, David, and Jack to claim the #1 spot?

Dynamic Difficulty: Choose between different driving modes, including a "Simulation" setting for those seeking a true-to-life racing challenge.

Buckle up and hit the gas—your journey to the winner's circle starts now!

The finish line is waiting for you. Grab your controllers, start your engine, and win the race in Racing Fever today!
